editorial:
Imagine getting sent on a fancy company trip to bond with your coworkers, only to find out your boss is actually a psycho. That is exactly what happens to a group of stressed-out young executives in this wild ride. You get to watch these corporate types, who are more worried about their promotions than their lives, try to survive a series of deadly games. The vibe is a mix of a high-end vacation and a nightmare, with plenty of jokes about office culture that make the scary parts feel even weirder. It is a fun way to see people in suits panic when things go south.

What really works here are the sudden twists that keep you guessing and the fast pace that never lets you get bored. The acting is great, especially the retreat leader who is creepy but funny. While some of the kills are a bit over the top, it just adds to the dark humor. You should definitely watch this if you like movies where people are put in impossible situations. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gore clearly, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the retreat leader was a former employee who was fired and ruined by the company years ago. He wanted the executives to feel the same pain he did. The main character survives by using a corporate handbook to trick the killer into a trap. She manages to kill him with a trophy and escapes just as the police arrive, making her the only one left to take over the company.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and survival horror movies.
